description: Source code for the EmployeeCSVImportAPI class, a REST API endpoint in the OrangeHRM system allowing CSV import of employee records. The class handles file validation, transaction management, and invokes a service to process CSV data.

classes.name: EmployeeCSVImportAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint for importing employee CSV data into OrangeHRM, supports file validation, transaction management, and execution of data import service.

methods.name: getPimCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the PimCsvDataImportService used for processing CSV data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; endpoint not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the get all operation; not implemented.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the CSV import request, validates attachment, manages a database transaction, invokes import service, and returns results.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the creation endpoint, primarily for attachment validation.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the CSV attachment, including base64 encoding and file format/extension checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; delete operation is not supported for this API.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation; not implemented.
